description: This file defines a class 'RestRequest' within the namespace 'JiraApi'. The class provides methods for constructing and executing REST API requests, including handling different HTTP verbs, authentication, and request body construction. It appears to facilitate interaction with Jira's REST API endpoints.

classes.name: RestRequest
classes.description: A class to handle HTTP REST API requests, including setting headers, request bodies, executing various HTTP methods, and handling responses.

methods.name: openConnect
methods.description: Initializes connection parameters and prepares the request body if needed.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Resets the request state and response data.

methods.description: Executes the REST API request based on the HTTP verb specified.

methods.name: buildPostBody
methods.description: Constructs the POST request body, handling JSON encoding or file upload multipart form data.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body from the executed request.

methods.name: getResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the response, such as HTTP status code.

methods.name: lastRequestStatus
methods.description: Checks if the last request was successful based on HTTP response code.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Performs the core execution of the cURL request and populates response data.
